alternatingChange.observation: Not blind: the historical baseline and numerical outcome are known. The upper-left branching cluster at 2500 clears and is replaced by a smaller cluster farther down the left edge at 3000. The dense lower-left lattice breaks into separated short lower clusters and small edge fragments. These are occupied-body and gap changes; band1 remains empty.
